sue-elhessen.text: (2024) As a Bellflower Unified board member, abstained when the board voted 3 to 1 (with her abstention) for a contract settlement and termination of Superintendent Dr. Ben Drati after 13 months.

source.title: Los Cerritos Community News: Bellflower Unified board fires Superintendent Dr. Drati (2024-02-09)
